query: I want to permanently close my account and delete all my personal information.

conversation_context.message: I want to permanently close my account.
I can help with account-related questions, but account closure requires a human agent.
Please connect me with someone who can close it.

query: There is a transaction on my account that I did not make. I think someone has stolen my account.

conversation_context.message: I see a transaction I don't recognize.
Can you confirm whether you made this transaction?
No, I definitely did not make it.
This needs to be reviewed by a human agent immediately.

query: Why was my refund partially rejected even though the entire order was cancelled?

conversation_context.message: I cancelled my entire order. Why did I only get part of my refund?
I couldn't find enough information in the available documents to determine why the refund was partial.
Can a human agent check this for me?

query: My payment was deducted twice for the same order. I need one of the payments refunded.

conversation_context.message: I was charged twice for the same order.
I can see that this issue requires payment verification by a human agent.
Okay, please have someone check it.

resolution_notes: Verified duplicate payment and initiated a refund for the second transaction.
